avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: MAOI activity combined with serotonergic effects increases risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently with rasagiline

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonin precursor; MAOI potentiates serotonergic effects leading to serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonin precursor; MAOI inhibition reduces serotonin metabolism
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; high risk of serotonin syndrome

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-Adenosyl Methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Serotonergic activity potentiated by MAOI mechanism
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Stimulant properties combined with MAOI may cause hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; risk of elevated blood pressure and cardiac effects

avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma Huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic amine; MAOI inhibits metabolism causing severe hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; high risk of hypertensive emergency

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild serotonergic activity; additive CNS depression possible
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive sedation or mood changes

caution_supplements.name: Passionflower
caution_supplements.mechanism: Minor serotonergic effects; potential for additive CNS activity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor patient; generally safe in typical doses

avoid_foods.name: Aged cheeses (cheddar, blue, brie, camembert, feta, mozzarella)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High tyramine content; MAOI prevents tyramine breakdown causing hypertensive crisis
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate from diet; educate patient on tyramine-containing foods

avoid_foods.name: Cured/processed meats (pepperoni, salami, sausage, bologna, bacon)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High tyramine content from fermentation and curing processes
avoid_foods.action: Avoid; choose fresh poultry and meats instead

avoid_foods.name: Fermented soy products (soy sauce, miso, tempeh, soy paste)
avoid_foods.action: Avoid or use minimal amounts; monitor for hypertensive symptoms

avoid_foods.name: Overripe or spoiled bananas
avoid_foods.mechanism: Tyramine increases with ripeness and decomposition
avoid_foods.action: Consume only fresh, ripe bananas in moderation; avoid overripe

avoid_foods.name: Broad bean pods (fava beans)
avoid_foods.mechanism: High tyramine content, especially in pods

caution_foods.name: Soy milk (fresh, non-fermented)
caution_foods.mechanism: Lower tyramine than fermented soy products but trace amounts present
caution_foods.action: Moderate intake acceptable; limit to 1-2 servings daily

caution_foods.name: Peanuts
caution_foods.mechanism: Minimal tyramine content but present in trace amounts
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; generally safe in typical quantities

caution_foods.name: Chocolate
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains trace tyramine and phenylethylamine; minimal clinical risk at normal consumption
caution_foods.action: Reasonable in moderation; excessive intake should be avoided

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing beverages (coffee, tea, cola)
caution_foods.mechanism: Stimulant effects may be potentiated; increased blood pressure risk at high doses
caution_foods.action: Limit to moderate intake; monitor blood pressure and cardiovascular symptoms

monitoring_notes: Rasagiline is a selective MAO-B inhibitor with lower tyramine interaction risk than non-selective MAOIs, but significant dietary restrictions remain essential. Monitor for hypertensive crisis symptoms (severe headache, chest pain, palpitations, confusion) and serotonin syndrome (agitation, tremor, rigidity, hyperthermia), particularly during initiation or dose escalation.
